summary:
Booking Holdings 2026年第二季營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，展現穩健的旅遊需求動能。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）實際值為 2.54 美元，優於預期的 2.43 美元。
• 季度營收達到 73.5 億美元，年增率為 8.15%。
• 受惠於強勁的全球旅遊需求，核心預訂業務維持穩健成長。
ai_view:
觀點：財報表現超越預期顯示旅遊需求具備韌性，對股價中短期具正面支撐；後續應追蹤總體經濟數據、消費者旅遊預算變化及競爭對手的市佔率變化。

需留意：總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響未來消費者的旅遊支出意願。；全球旅遊市場競爭加劇，可能對行銷費用及利潤率造成壓力。

summary_en:
Booking Holdings reported Q2 2026 revenue and EPS that beat expectations, demonstrating solid travel demand.
• EPS actual came in at $2.54, beating the estimated $2.43.
• Quarterly revenue reached $7.35B, representing an 8.15% year-over-year increase.
• Core booking business maintained solid growth driven by strong global travel demand.

ai_view_en:
View: The earnings beat demonstrates resilient travel demand providing positive support for the stock in the near-to-mid term. Key metrics to track include macroeconomic data, changes in consumer travel budgets, and competitor market share shifts.

Watch：Macroeconomic uncertainties could impact future consumer willingness to spend on travel.; Increased competition in the global travel market may pressure marketing expenses and margins.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，營收與每股盈餘皆高於分析師預估值。
